bloc.Ce module constate ce qui est déclaré ;: This module records what is declared; it does not qualify your product for you. The class drives the procedure, and therefore the budget and the timetable: you choose it, and the annexes are shown alongside so that the choice is an informed one. The sectoral exclusions and the general clause of Article # are a matter for legal analysis, not a ticked box. Only the text published in the Official Journal is authentic.
bloc.Ce module ne chiffre que ce que le texte: This module only puts figures on what the text puts figures on. It estimates no compliance cost — neither person-days nor notified body fees: these figures are neither in the Regulation nor reliably public, and inventing them would produce a document that looks like a quote without being one. The amounts above are ceilings, not forecasts: Article #(#) requires account to be taken of the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, previous infringements and the size of the company. The penalty regime itself is set by each Member State.
bloc.Cette qualification suit ce que vous déc: This qualification follows what you declare. In law it is established on the actual facts — in particular the notion of substantial modification, which is assessed with regard to the product’s cybersecurity, not the technical extent of the change. A minor patch that reopens an attack surface can be substantial; an overhaul that does not touch it may not be.
bloc.La notification part simultanément au CS: The notification goes simultaneously to the CSIRT designated as coordinator and to ENISA, through the single reporting platform of Article #. Notifying one and then the other, or only one of them, is not what the text requires.
bloc.Une exigence non renseignée n'est pas un: A requirement that is not filled in is not a compliant requirement. The rate displayed always comes with the number of empty rows: a rate calculated on three requirements filled in says nothing about the other eighteen.
